title: trailboss --json sweep
description: The agents and tasks started from a session (--parent, else the one sweep runs in) and their children, then what comes next: the decisions only you can make first, then what agents are doing on their own. Children come from `live`'s parent, `task add --parent` and `start --parent`. Sweep only reads: it types nothing and changes nothing. Frontends should show a state or kind they don't know as is.

rows.description: Breadth first: the session's tasks, the agents `start` started, then other agents nested under it; then each one's own.

kind.description: agent (started with `start`, or nested under the session in a host or by process) or task; more may be added.

name.description: A task's number and brief's first line, else the agent's label, session title or where it runs.

n.description: The task's number; null for an agent.

session.description: AGENT:ID of its session, while known.

parent.description: AGENT:ID of the session it was started from.

depth.description: 0 for one started from the swept session, 1 for its children's, and so on.

where.description: Where its agent runs, as `live` says; for an agent that ended, the terminal it ran in.

state.description: An agent's: working, needs you, done (at rest after its turn) or ended. A task's, as `task ls` says: to do, working, needs you, ready, done or missing. More may be added.

detail.description: Why: its status, what it waits on, or how it ended.

needs.description: What it waits on you for, as `live` says.

turn_ended_ms.description: When its last turn ended, while running.

said.description: The first non-empty line of its agent's last message, from the local index.

base.description: The branch a task started from.

commits.description: Commits on a task's branch its base doesn't have; null for agents and done tasks.

pr.description: The open, merged or closed PR whose head is the task's branch, through `gh`; null when there's none, for agents, for done tasks, or when `gh` couldn't say (see gh_note).

ci.description: passing, failing, pending, or none (no checks); more may be added.

mergeable.description: Whether GitHub can merge it; null while GitHub hasn't worked it out.

conflicts.description: Whether it conflicts with its base; null while unknown.

unresolved_threads.description: Review threads not resolved, bots' included (the first 100); null when `gh` couldn't say (see gh_note).

gh_note.description: Why the PR fields are unknown: `gh` isn't installed, isn't signed in, or failed. Sweep goes on without them.

next.description: At most one step per row: every decision before any wait, every wait before any info.

kind.description: decision (yours: answer an agent, accept a task, merge a PR, fix failing CI, resolve conflicts or review threads) wait (an agent or CI is working) or info (an agent at rest after its turn that asks nothing); more may be added.

text.description: What to do or what is happening, for people.
